issues.field: documents counted as provided / repair_quote (and the repair cost it supports)
issues.recorded: repair_quote counted as provided for policy VER-1003 (Ines Haddad, Toyota Yaris 2019) and repair cost €980 taken from it
issues.should_be: the repair quote must belong to the policyholder Ines Haddad and the insured vehicle (Toyota Yaris 2019); the attached quote is made out to Mr. Julien Roche for a Renault Clio (2017), registration DX-482-KD, so it cannot be counted as this policyholder's repair quote
issues.evidence: repair_quote.pdf (uploaded attachment, quote no. Q-2610-5320): Customer 'Mr. Julien Roche', Vehicle 'Renault Clio (2017), Registration DX-482-KD'; Policy Schedule for VER-1003 lists holder Ines Haddad and vehicle Toyota Yaris (2019). Contract Article 4.3 (document 2630#10414, page 2) requires a repair quote for the C2 claim, and the review rules require each counted document to belong to this policyholder and vehicle

verdict.summary: All other facts check out (C2 collision covered in the schedule, reported 2026-10-29 within the 5-day deadline of Article 4.1, policyholder at fault with no third party so the commercial-vehicle playbook rule does not apply, no exclusion under Article 3, €300 deductible and no assessor since €980 ≤ €1,500 per Articles 5-6), but the only repair quote on file is for a different customer and a different vehicle (Julien Roche, Renault Clio DX-482-KD) instead of Ines Haddad's Toyota Yaris, so the quote — and the €980 repair cost derived from it — cannot be accepted as this policyholder's document.
